title: A planted heal cut, declared against measured
author: lane/lab-p2-readers
question: Does a planted heal cut move the sustain readers, and does it move anything the model graph does not declare?
hypothesis: Every heal a hero takes landing at half (tools/balance-program/experiments/heal-cut.patch.json, the quantity heal.cut up) moves regenShare up and sustainRatio down on most cells, beyond the sweeps' rule (graph/measured.mjs). Every outcome that moves is one the graph's trace from heal.cut reaches, so the compare names no undeclared-move finding

results.name: EX-0002-base.json
results.what: The base run: readers.mjs --play on the tree, subset blocks ways, tier, four and lineups, 2 seeds of 1 h

results.name: EX-0002-healcut.json
results.what: The planted run: the same plan and dice on a scratch copy with heal-cut.patch.json

results.name: EX-0002-declared-at-hypothesis.json
results.what: readers.mjs --declared base planted --moves heal.cut=+1, run by the tree as it stood at the hypothesis (9cd6983ea)

summary.plan: subset blocks ways, tier, four and lineups: 187 cells, 2 seeds of 1 h, plan 26ce5570e063, the same plan and dice on both sides
summary.model: the tree at 9cd6983ea, where the hypothesis was written

sustain.sustainRatio: declared down, measured down: 24 of 187 cells moved, 0 up, median -35.1%
sustain.regenShare: declared mixed, measured up: 106 of 187 cells moved, 104 up, median +16.4%
sustain.manaWaitsPerH: declared down, measured flat: 2 of 177 cells moved

conclusion: Refuted as written. The sustain readers moved as the trace declared: sustainRatio down on 24 cells with none up, and regenShare up on 104 of 106 moved cells where the trace read it mixed. manaWaitsPerH did not move: the reference bars almost never wait for mana, so this plant cannot test it. But the cut also moved four outcomes no path declared: dps and dpsHero down on 13 cells, killsPerH down on 16 and healPerH down on 30 of 31. Each is a gap in the model, not in the engine: a hero whose hunt ended deals and kills no more while the party hunts on, and a cut on what a heal lands lowers healing received. The model was taught both (EX-0004)
